newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Commercial up 2.4 pct on growth prospects.
newsitem.headline: Commercial up 2.4 pct on growth prospects.

text.p: Shares of Commercial Bank of Ceylon Ltd rose 2.4 perent or five rupees to 210 rupees on Wednesday on good growth prospects for the current financial year, brokers said.
Investors bought the shares because the bank "is expected to see a very good year, mainly due to its exposure to the plantation sector, which is expected to do very well in 1997," said a broker.
Commercial Bank is one of four private commercial banks listed in Colombo.
Shares of National Development Bank Ltd also rose on investor buying, brokers said. The bank's shares gained 2.3 percent or five rupees to 225.
